description: UrbanWater connects EPANET 2 with PostgreSQL and PostGIS so a single database can construct hydraulic models, run simulations and store results. Its procedures use pgSQL and Python and execute through SQL statements. This resource is provided by Nuno M. Martinho; José-Paulo DUARTE de ALMEIDA; Nuno E. Simões and coauthors. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The release accompanies one method paper and case application; operational maintenance is not established. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
